title: 大锤还是手术刀？一种用于隐式仇恨言论的细粒度自适应框架
summary: 针对隐式仇恨言论检测，提出FAID框架，先细粒度分类（浅层、定向、上下文依赖），再自适应处理：浅层用轻量提示调优，定向用知识增强迭代揭示隐藏目标，上下文依赖用智能体框架生成提示推断背景。在四个基准上超越SOTA。
summary_en: Proposes FAID, a fine-grained adaptive framework for implicit hate speech detection, categorizing samples into shallow, targeted, and context-dependent, and applying tailored strategies (prompt-tuning, knowledge augmentation, agentic reasoning) to improve efficiency and accuracy, outperforming SOTA on four benchmarks.
